mapper.update: UPDATE CONTACT_MECH SET INFO_STRING = NULL WHERE INFO_STRING IS NOT NULL AND CONTACT_MECH_ID IN (SELECT PC.CONTACT_MECH_ID FROM PARTY_CONTACT_MECH PC INNER JOIN PARTY PA ON PA.PARTY_ID = PC.PARTY_ID AND PA.PARTY_TYPE_ID = 'PERSON' AND PA.STATUS_ID = 'PARTY_DISABLED' AND PA.END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND PA.END_DATE < #{expirationDate} AND PA.PARTY_NAME <> PA.PARTY_ID)
mapper.select: SELECT UL.USER_LOGIN_ID AS USER_LOGIN_ID, CM.INFO_STRING FROM PARTY_CONTACT_MECH P JOIN CONTACT_MECH CM ON CM.CONTACT_MECH_ID = P.CONTACT_MECH_ID JOIN USER_LOGIN UL ON UL.PARTY_ID = P.PARTY_ID WHERE CONTACT_MECH_TYPE_ID='EMAIL_ADDRESS' and (P.PARTY_ID = #{username} or CM.INFO_STRING = #{username} or UL.user_login_id = #{username})

select cm.info_string from party_contact_mech p join contact_mech cm on cm.contact_mech_id = p.contact_mech_id JOIN USER_LOGIN UL ON UL.PARTY_ID = P.PARTY_ID where contact_mech_type_id = 'EMAIL_ADDRESS' and UL.user_login_id = #{username}
